<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    // Select all "Read more" buttons
    const readMoreBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.read-more-btn');

    readMoreBtns.forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            // Use closest() to find the shared container
            // Note: Ensure your HTML containers have a common class (e.g., .content-wrapper)
            const container = this.closest('.content-wrapper');

            if (!container) {
                console.error('Could not find a container with class .content-wrapper for this button.');
                return;
            }

            // Find the specific content element inside THAT container
            const content = container.querySelector('.read-more-content');

            if (!content) {
                console.error('Could not find an element with class .read-more-content inside the container.');
                return;
            }

            // Toggle visibility and text
            if (content.style.display === 'none' || getComputedStyle(content).display === 'none') {
                content.style.display = 'inline'; // Use 'block' if you want the content on a new line
                this.textContent = 'See less ▴';
            } else {
                content.style.display = 'none';
                this.textContent = 'Read more ▾';
            }
        });
    });
});

</script>








<script>
(function(){

  function ensureMainLandmark(){

    const root = document.getElementById("root");

    if(!root) return;

    if(root.querySelector("main,[role='main']")) return;

    const first = Array.from(root.children).find(
      el => el.tagName !== "SCRIPT" && el.tagName !== "STYLE"
    );

    if(first)
      first.setAttribute("role","main");

  }

  window.addEventListener("load",ensureMainLandmark);

})();
</script>

<script>
/* ============================================================================
   GOOGLE - Comparison-1 vs dMs4WkOYD (2-way) — PURE POSTHOG redirect (flag-driven)
   PostHog project: HTLH - GOOGLE (208779) · flag: google-comparison1-v2
   Experiment: https://eu.posthog.com/project/208779/experiments/91531

   control = Comparison 1 -> https://www.techunboxed.co/article/comparison-1  (ENTRY — paste here)
   test    = dMs4WkOYD    -> https://www.techunboxed.co/article/dMs4WkOYD

   GOOGLE FUNNEL: Google-sourced traffic (gclid) makes the header init PostHog with the
   GOOGLE token, so this flag MUST live in the Google project (a Native flag would be
   invisible to these visitors). Paste on the ENTRY / control page (/article/comparison-1)
   ONLY. PostHog assigns 50/50. getFeatureFlag fires the $feature_flag_called exposure;
   'test' is redirected to dMs4WkOYD; control stays. White cover hides the flash,
   loop-guarded, ALL query params + hash carried over.

   REQUIRES the Google header (Google Funnels/lf-header-tracking.html) with
   request_batching:false — otherwise the exposure is batched (~3s) and the 500ms
   redirect fires before it sends, under-counting the 'test' arm. Re-paste that header
   before launching. Experiment is created as a draft — launch when ready.
   ============================================================================ */
(function () {
  if (!window.posthog) return;

  var TEST_URL  = "https://www.techunboxed.co/article/dMs4WkOYD";
  var TEST_PATH = "/article/dMs4WkOYD";

  // LOOP GUARD: if already on the test page, do nothing.
  if (window.location.pathname.indexOf(TEST_PATH) !== -1) return;

  // White cover (no flash before redirect).
  var cover = document.createElement("div");
  cover.id = "ph-ab-cover";
  cover.setAttribute("style",
    "position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;background:#ffffff;" +
    "z-index:2147483647;opacity:1;transition:opacity .2s ease;");
  (document.body || document.documentElement).appendChild(cover);
  function reveal() {
    cover.style.opacity = "0";
    setTimeout(function () { if (cover && cover.parentNode) cover.parentNode.removeChild(cover); }, 250);
  }
  var safety = setTimeout(reveal, 2500);

  posthog.onFeatureFlags(function () {
    clearTimeout(safety);
    if (posthog.getFeatureFlag("google-comparison1-v2") !== "test") { reveal(); return; } // control stays
    var url;
    try {
      var dest = new URL(TEST_URL);
      new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).forEach(function (v, k) { dest.searchParams.set(k, v); });
      dest.hash = window.location.hash;
      url = dest.toString();
    } catch (e) {
      url = TEST_URL + window.location.search + window.location.hash;
    }
    // Delay the redirect so PostHog sends the $feature_flag_called exposure BEFORE
    // we navigate away — otherwise the redirected variant (test) gets under-counted.
    setTimeout(function () { window.location.replace(url); }, 500);
  });
})();
</script>
